description: Check a list of packages for known vulnerabilities via OSV.dev, then join with Patchfirst exploitation data (CISA KEV, EPSS, priority, ATT&CK techniques). Results are sorted exploited-first so you fix what attackers actually use. Ecosystems use OSV names: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist, Debian, Alpine, etc.

version.description: Installed version. Omit to list all known vulns for the package.
